assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit target: image 1, Orena circular geometric logo. Image 2 is ONLY a texture/style reference, never reproduce its landscape, text or branding. Create a square standalone artwork for a personal portfolio opening. Preserve the exact centered Orena symbol: two concentric interrupted rings, exact negative spaces and horizontal split, proportions unchanged. Turn the pale symbol into chalky cream pigment with very fine stippled, fuzzy painterly edges and visible matte paper grain. Background deep warm charcoal #141411 with subtle dense pigment grain, no extra objects. Keep its original ample border. Feel like softly airbrushed gouache and textured risograph pigment, as tangible and grainy as the reference, not just a digital noise filter. No words, borders, shadow mockups or added symbols. Nontransparent background.
